subject: Urgent: sustained headroom breach impacting NimBusPay production - immediate mitigations
messages:
From: James Park <james.park@nimbuspay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: NimBusPay SRE <sre@nimbuspay.com>, procurement@nimbuspay.com
Date: 2027-06-07T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production alerts: sustained latency + errors tied to reserved throughput

Hannah —

We're seeing a persistent regression in our production calls to the Redwood dedicated pool starting ~02:30 PT this morning. Key symptoms: 3x median tail latency for the short prompt flows, token-level error rate spikes (502/504) for a subset of endpoints, and our reserved throughput is showing a sustained shortfall versus our committed QPS. This is hitting the user-facing recommendation flow.

Attached is a short error dump and a single snapshot of pool metrics. Our customers are seeing slowdowns and intermittent failures. We urgently need a mitigation plan and an ETA for a fix. We have a reserved contract (RBW-4721) and procurement is looking for a remediation timeline before engaging legal.

Files attached: nimbuspay_error_summary_0607.csv, pool_metrics_snapshot_0607.png

Can you confirm receipt and expected next steps?

James
Head of Platform
NimBusPay
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Team — FYI and urgent. NimBusPay is seeing a sustained headroom breach in their dedicated pool and token errors. They're on a reserved contract and asking for a remediation ETA. I want a quick triage, an immediate mitigation plan we can share with James, and a proposed timeline for permanent remediation.

Initial asks:
- Quick root-cause triage (Marcus)
- Temporary mitigations (fallbacks/burst into hosted, cache bypasses) and cost impact (Neha)
- Customer comms content and M.A.P. update (Marissa)

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Park <james.park@nimbuspay.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production alerts: sustained latency + errors tied to reserved throughput

Quick triage notes (summary):
- Root signal: sustained queue growth on the NimBusPay dedicated pool controllers around 02:25 PT. Autoscaler did not add headroom because the pool hit a hard vGPU allocation cap (reserved-only cluster).
- Secondary: a single customer route started producing longer sequence lengths after a model update on their side which increased per-request token cost; combined with bursty traffic from batch jobs it exhausted available request concurrency.
- Error mode: 502s originate from pool frontends timing out while waiting for backends to allocate KV cache slots during high-concurrency bursts.

Immediate mitigations (actionable):
1) Short window rotate: allow NimBusPay to burst to our hosted fallback model (compatible variant) for 2 hours to shed load from dedicated pool. Requires ops flip and cost acceptance from Sales/Finance.
2) Emergency soft-limit: reduce per-tenant concurrency cap temporarily to limit queue growth (low latency but may increase tail for some requests).
3) Prefix KV pruning: a temporary cache-trimming policy for the pool for 30 minutes to free KV slots for hot flows.

I'll prepare a runbook for executing (1) and (2) now. ETA for first mitigation (hosted burst) deployment: 25 minutes if Finance approves cost & legal is fine with data routing note (we'll keep logs redacted).

Marcus
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Context + commercial constraints:
- NimBusPay is on a committed reserved capacity plan that includes limited burst credits per month. If we route to hosted for an extended period they will incur overage or we need to authorize a credit. Procurement has looped in (procurement@nimbuspay.com).
- Cost estimate for 2-hour hosted fallback for their current peak: ~ $3.4k (ballpark) — can be absorbed as a one-time customer credit if leadership signs off.
- Contract note: we must document the fallback as an approved emergency fallback and add to the mutual action plan. Will draft MAP v2 and attach.

I'll coordinate with Finance on the credit; Priyom / Marissa pls include this estimate in the customer note.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Product GTM

  * Apply temporary per-tenant concurrency cap to 40% of prior setting at 10:50 PT.
  * Run cache-prune window for 30 minutes starting 10:55 PT.
  * Draft MAP v2 and capture credit authorization (Neha / Marissa).
- Customer impact: intermittent 502s and elevated tail latency; user-facing recommendation flows degraded.
- ETA for customer-facing update: 11:10 PT (we will confirm the mitigation results and expected timeline for permanent fix).
- Exec level: Hannah, please advise if you want VP notices. I will draft an internal exec note for Rory (VP Sales) and Priya (Head of Product) once mitigations are running.

I'll attach the MAP draft and the incident link to the customer note.

Priyom Das
